# Simulate conversations between fictional personalities

> Build fictional characters with Big Five personalities and simulate negotiations, team meetings and arguments between them. Free, private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/persona-conversation-simulator/)
- [Big Five personality traits and conflict: who clashes, and why](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/persona-conversation-simulator/big-five-personality-conflict-styles.html)
